title: fix: apply header_provider headers during MCP initialization (#7507)
what_broke: MCPTools/MultiMCPTools with a header_provider crashed at initialization with a TypeError when the SSE/streamable-HTTP params had no headers.

team_evidence.quote: When `header_provider` returns a non-empty dict, initialization crashes before the first network call with `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not a mapping`.
team_evidence.source: fix commit a72674fc message (PR #7548, "Fixes the init-time header_provider merge regression introduced in #7507")

title: fix(openai): handle proxy responses with missing/null choices; undo test change Avoid indexing response.choices[0] when proxies return choices=null/empty; raise a clear ModelProviderError (with base_url hint) and use the validated first choice for content/finish_reason
what_broke: A mis-indented block in ChatOpenAI skipped the structured-output request whenever add_schema_to_system_prompt was false (the default), so agent steps through ChatOpenAI failed.

team_evidence.quote: Fix indentation so structured-output request executes even when add_schema_to_system_prompt is false
team_evidence.source: fix commit 1629799d message ("fix(openai): structured output call shouldn't depend on schema injection")

title: feat(code): integrate Hooks v2 server lifecycle events (#4997)
what_broke: The Hooks v2 middleware, installed on every agent and subagent, leaked its state into subagent results, so two parallel task completions crashed the parent turn.

team_evidence.quote: When two `task` calls completed in the same graph step, LangGraph received two writes for one single-value channel and raised `InvalidUpdateError`, failing the parent turn.
team_evidence.source: fix commit 88ea7da1 message (PR #5164); second fix 08e6e8ba (PR #5176) for hook resumes

title: fix(sdk): handle large payloads and headless container execution (#872)
what_broke: BaseSandbox write/edit templates contained unescaped {e}/{file_path}, so str.format() raised KeyError and every sandbox write/edit failed.

team_evidence.quote: The heredoc-based templates introduced in #872 contain f-string placeholders like {e} and {file_path} that are incorrectly processed by Python's str.format() method, causing KeyError exceptions.
team_evidence.source: fix commit dc770827 message ("Fixes regression introduced in: .../pull/872")

title: fix(query): always return list[str] from generate_sub_queries
what_broke: An annotation used names before typing was imported, so gpt_researcher failed to import on Python 3.13 and below.

team_evidence.quote: query_processing.py annotated _normalize_sub_queries with Any/List before importing typing, raising NameError at import on Python <=3.13 (eager annotations). Broke the PyPI wheel, both Dockerfiles and runtime.txt.

title: Ruff, update prompts, add think tool, update defaults (#163)
Fix: Resolve strftime ValueError on Windows (#126)
what_broke: A Windows strftime fix called datetime.datetime.now() where datetime was the class, so get_today_str raised AttributeError in every run.

team_evidence.quote: fix: AttributeError: type object 'datetime.datetime' has no attribute 'datetime' (#178)

title: Use contextvars for tracking the MCP sampling model (#2117)
what_broke: Tracking the MCP sampling model in a contextvar meant the sampling model override did not take effect inside agent.run_mcp_servers(), so MCP sampling requests went to the wrong model.

team_evidence.quote: The `override_sampling_model` context manager didn't work when already the `async with agent.run_mcp_servers()` context
team_evidence.source: PR #2132 description (fix d10f036d), fetched from github.com

title: feat: implement concurrent message reading for session managers (#897)
what_broke: Concurrent message loading used asyncio.run inside the session managers, so agents with a File/S3 session manager failed in async code.

team_evidence.quote: since this is a breaking change, we are going to revert the change and work on the fix separately
team_evidence.source: revert PR #1013 description (fix 92da5445), fetched from github.com; it quotes the error "cannot be called from a running event loop"
